title: Two-factor auth in 60 seconds
caption: Two-factor authentication in 60 seconds: how those six-digit codes work, with no internet connection.

scenes.say: A password is something you know, and it can leak. Two-factor adds something you have, like your phone.
Authenticator apps don't need a connection.

items.title: Shared secret
items.say: When you scan the QR code, your phone and the site share a secret.

items.title: Time
items.say: Both sides know the current time.

items.title: Code
items.say: Mix the secret with the time, and you get the same six digits on both.

scenes.code:
code = HMAC(secret, now / 30s)
      → 6 digits

new code every 30 seconds
scenes.say: A new code every thirty seconds, so a stolen one goes stale fast.
That's two-factor. A thief needs your password and your phone.
